verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents controls over whether logs and payloads are stored, via the cf-aig-collect-log and cf-aig-collect-log-payload headers. That is a related but different control: nothing shows a user can choose the region or residency where data is stored. Data residency is a fair question for an AI gateway that persists logs, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
